comparison.objective: Clock an open shell 90° around an airborne held shaft; candidate adjusts and locks a damper collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Both include relative rotation with stabilization, but PR-1432 performs large bimanual free-space shell motion around a shaft; candidate uses a hex tool and fine collar rotation against a mounted mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1432 requires a 90° relative pose while both bodies remain lifted; detailed tolerances are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate validates dynamic stopping and post-lock drift.
comparison.reason: Relative rotation is shared, but the candidate uniquely tests tool-mediated unlocking, tuning, relocking, and machine response.
